meta.about_html:
Permanent Marker is a top-tier hybrid cannabis strain celebrated for its unmatched potency, bold aroma, and award-winning genetic lineage.

This indica-leaning hybrid comes from a powerhouse three-way cross: Biscotti × Sherb Bx × Jealousy. With THC levels ranging from 25% to 35%+, Permanent Marker delivers a deep, calming high paired with euphoric mental clarity. Users often describe the experience as a smooth blend of creative uplift, tingly relaxation, and full-body unwinding, making it ideal for both recreational enjoyment and targeted relief.

Why Is Permanent Marker So Popular?

Permanent Marker has quickly become a hype strain that consistently sells out thanks to these standout qualities:

Unique Hybrid Effects

Permanent Marker offers a balanced experience that blends mental stimulation with profound physical relaxation. Many users report feeling:

  • Euphoric
  • Calm and tingly
  • Mentally uplifted
  • Creatively inspired

Because this strain leans slightly indica without being sedating, it’s ideal for unwinding, social use, or evening creativity.

Key Features of Permanent Marker

  • THC Content: 25–35%+
  • Lineage: Biscotti × Sherb Bx × Jealousy
  • Flavor & Aroma: Chemical marker funk, floral candy, sour citrus diesel, soapy sweetness
  • Effects: Euphoric uplift, tingly calm, full-body relaxation
  • Best For: Stress relief, mood elevation, creative sessions, evening relaxation

Explore Similar Strains

If you enjoy Permanent Marker, explore these terp-rich, high-potency hybrids on our menu:

  • Cherry Popperz (3.5g) – Sweet, relaxing hybrid with smooth body release.
  • BISCOTTI MINTZ – 3.5G White Label Mylar – Dessert-forward hybrid with heavy indica traits.
  • Wizard Trees – Dark Matter (3.5g) – Exotic, gassy hybrid with deep mental stimulation.
  • Plum Popperz (3.5g / 7g) – Fruity, flavorful, and ideal for evening use.
  • DOJA – Peachtree 3.5G – A juicy, uplifting hybrid perfect for daytime creativity.
  • STIIIZY OG – 3.5G Black Label Mylar – Classic OG effects with strong potency.

2. Permanent Marker Strain Composition Breakdown

Permanent Marker stands out for its exceptionally potent cannabinoid profile and terpene-rich composition, creating a deeply immersive, flavorful, and long-lasting cannabis experience. With THC levels that often reach 30% or higher, this strain delivers powerful calming effects, euphoric mental stimulation, and full-body relaxation that appeal to both recreational enthusiasts and medical users.

THC Content: 25% – 35%+ Permanent Marker is an exceptionally high-THC strain, making it a top choice for experienced users and heavy consumers. Its powerful cannabinoid concentration delivers an immediate euphoric lift followed by a deeply calming, tingly body sensation that defines its signature effects.

CBD Content: ~0% With virtually no CBD present, Permanent Marker’s effects are driven almost entirely by its potent THC and terpene synergy. This makes it ideal for those seeking intense stress relief, mood elevation, and a strong, relaxing evening experience.

CBG Content: ~0.5–1% Trace levels of cannabigerol (CBG) contribute supportive therapeutic benefits, including anti-inflammatory properties and subtle mood regulation. This enhances the strain’s overall calming nature without reducing potency.

CBN Content: Trace Minimal cannabinol (CBN) may offer a slight boost to Permanent Marker’s relaxing qualities, assisting with muscle tension release and promoting deeper physical calm without inducing full sedation.

Myrcene: The dominant terpene in Permanent Marker, myrcene contributes to its deeply calming, tingly body effects. Known for enhancing THC absorption through increased cell permeability, myrcene intensifies the strain’s overall potency while supporting its earthy, slightly sweet base aroma.

Caryophyllene: This peppery, resinous terpene plays a major role in Permanent Marker’s signature gassy, chemical-like profile. As the only terpene known to bind directly with the body’s CB2 receptors, caryophyllene provides notable anti-inflammatory and stress-relieving benefits, adding to the strain’s soothing and grounding qualities.

Limonene: Limonene brings a bright, citrus-forward lift to Permanent Marker’s aroma, helping balance the strain’s heavier notes with hints of lemon zest and candy-like sweetness. Known for its mood-enhancing and anxiety-reducing properties, limonene contributes to the strain’s euphoric cerebral effects and creative mental clarity.

Entourage Effect: Permanent Marker is a powerful showcase of the "entourage effect," where its high THC content and terpene-rich profile work together to amplify both therapeutic and recreational effects.

The combination of elevated THC levels and dominant myrcene creates a deeply calming, tingly body sensation that sets in quickly and lasts for hours. Limonene contributes an uplifting mental clarity and euphoric spark, helping balance the strain’s heavier relaxing qualities. Meanwhile, caryophyllene—known for interacting directly with CB2 receptors—supports stress relief, mood stabilization, and anti-inflammatory benefits, making Permanent Marker ideal for users seeking strong relaxation without excessive sedation.

meta.effects_headline: What Permanent Marker actually feels like.
meta.effects_html:
Permanent Marker is widely praised for its potent blend of euphoric uplift and deep physical relaxation, offering a balanced hybrid experience that leans slightly indica. Users often report a fast-acting wave of elevated mood and mental clarity, followed by a soothing, tingly body high that melts away stress and tension. Thanks to its high THC levels—often 30% or higher—Permanent Marker can deliver intensely immersive effects that are especially appealing to experienced users.

The strain’s euphoric onset makes it excellent for creative sessions, introspection, or unwinding after a demanding day, while its calming finish supports full-body ease without inducing complete sedation. Its potency makes it best suited for evening or late-afternoon use, particularly for those seeking relief from stress, low mood, or physical discomfort.

Mental and Physical Relief

Permanent Marker’s rich cannabinoid and terpene composition contributes to a range of wellness-oriented benefits. On the mental health side, many users report:

  • Reduced stress and anxiety
  • Elevated mood and emotional clarity
  • Relief from negative thought patterns
  • Improved creative focus

These effects make Permanent Marker a potentially useful strain for individuals managing anxiety, chronic stress, or mild to moderate depression symptoms.

Medical Use Cases

Thanks to its high potency and balanced hybrid chemistry, Permanent Marker is commonly used to help manage:

  • Stress and anxiety-related conditions
  • PTSD symptoms
  • Chronic fatigue and burnout
  • Muscle spasms or tension
  • Mild insomnia, especially for those who have difficulty winding down
  • Chronic pain disorders, including migraines, arthritis, or inflammation
  • Mood imbalance, including low motivation or irritability

While not a substitute for medical treatment, Permanent Marker’s wellness-oriented profile makes it a versatile option for a wide range of users.

Side Effects and Usage Tips

Like many high-THC designer strains, Permanent Marker may produce side effects—especially for new or low-tolerance users. Potential side effects include:

  • Dry mouth
  • Dry eyes
  • Mild dizziness
  • Temporary anxiety or paranoia (typically in high doses)

To ensure a positive experience:

  • Start low and increase gradually, especially for first-time users
  • Stay hydrated before and during consumption
  • Consume in a comfortable environment
  • Avoid mixing with alcohol or other sedatives
  • Choose evening or low-responsibility settings due to potency

Permanent Marker’s intensity is part of what makes it so prized among connoisseurs—but respecting its strength ensures the best experience.

4. Permanent Marker Flavor and Aroma
meta.flavor_headline: How Permanent Marker tastes and smells.
meta.flavor_html:
Permanent Marker offers one of the boldest, most layered flavor and aroma profiles in modern cannabis, combining pungent chemical notes with sweet candy-like undertones and rich gassy funk. From the moment you crack open the jar to the final exhale, this strain delivers a sensory experience that is both intense and unmistakable—perfect for connoisseurs who appreciate complex, terpene-heavy strains.

Flavor Profile

On the inhale, Permanent Marker delivers an immediate burst of sweet floral candy mixed with soapy, citrus-forward brightness. This transitions into deeper notes of diesel gas, tobacco earthiness, and a subtle chemical edge reminiscent of its namesake scent.

As the vapor or smoke settles, users commonly note a lingering sweet-and-sour finish with hints of citrus rind and floral fuel, giving the strain its signature multi-dimensional flavor. This blend of sweet, pungent, and gassy notes makes Permanent Marker a highly unique and memorable strain.

Aroma Profile

Permanent Marker’s aroma is extremely bold and instantly recognizable. Opening a fresh nug releases a sharp wave of:

  • Marker-like chemical funk
  • Sweet, fruity florals
  • Sour citrus
  • Pungent gas
  • Slight herbal and earthy undertones

As the flower breaks apart, the scent intensifies into a room-filling bouquet of chemical sweetness and diesel-heavy funk—one of the reasons this strain has become a favorite among terpene enthusiasts.

Terpenes Behind the Flavor

Permanent Marker owes its rich and unusual flavor profile to a potent blend of dominant terpenes:

Myrcene

Myrcene lays the foundation with its earthy, herbal softness, contributing to the strain’s calming and tingly body feel. It also enhances THC absorption, increasing the depth of the overall experience.

Limonene

Limonene introduces bright citrus highlights that give Permanent Marker its sweet lemon-candy sparkle. Known for mood elevation and stress reduction, limonene balances the strain’s heavier components with uplifting clarity.

Caryophyllene

Caryophyllene adds a spicy, peppery depth that enhances the strain’s fuel-like character. As the only terpene that binds directly to CB2 receptors, it offers anti-inflammatory and stress-relieving benefits that round out Permanent Marker’s relaxing finish.

meta.cultivation_html:
Growing Permanent Marker can be a highly rewarding endeavor for cultivators aiming to produce top-shelf, high-THC, terpene-dense flower. While not overly difficult to manage, this strain does best in the hands of growers with some experience due to its dense bud structure, heavy resin production, and sensitivity to humidity.

Difficulty: Moderate Permanent Marker is best suited for growers with some experience. Its dense, highly resinous buds and strong terpene output require attentive environmental control to prevent moisture-related issues and maintain top-tier flower quality.

Climate: Warm, dry, and low humidity This strain performs exceptionally well in a controlled, Mediterranean-like climate. For indoor grows, maintain temperatures between 68–80°F and keep humidity below 50% during late flowering to protect its thick, sticky buds from mold and mildew.

Plant Structure: Medium height with dense, colorful, trichome-heavy buds Permanent Marker develops a sturdy frame with tight internodal spacing, supporting large, resin-coated colas. Regular pruning and low-stress training (LST) help improve airflow, enhance terpene production, and maximize both light penetration and overall yields.

Flowering Time: 8–10 weeks Permanent Marker typically reaches full maturity within 8 to 10 weeks indoors. Its flowering period is moderate, and with proper environmental control, growers can expect dense, resin-heavy buds with exceptional bag appeal and terpene expression.

Indoor Yield: Approximately 350–450g/m² Indoors, Permanent Marker performs well under consistent lighting, airflow, and humidity management. Using training methods such as LST or ScrOG can increase canopy efficiency, promote even bud development, and enhance overall yield potential.

Outdoor Yield: Harvest by mid to late October When cultivated outdoors in warm, dry conditions, Permanent Marker is generally ready for harvest by mid to late October. Outdoor plants can produce significantly larger yields, especially in regions with abundant sunlight and low humidity throughout the flowering stage.

Growing Techniques: LST, ScrOG, and Defoliation Permanent Marker responds exceptionally well to Low-Stress Training (LST) and Screen of Green (ScrOG) techniques. These methods help widen the canopy, improve light distribution, and increase bud site exposure. Light defoliation during early to mid-flower further boosts airflow and terpene production, supporting the strain’s dense, resin-rich structure.

Indoor Setup: Controlled humidity and strong airflow Maintaining airflow is critical for Permanent Marker due to its thick, sticky buds. Keep humidity below 50% during flowering, use oscillating fans to prevent hotspots, and ensure proper exhaust ventilation. These steps reduce the risk of mold and help preserve the strain’s rich aroma and terpene profile.

Outdoor Setup: Warm, dry climate with full sun Permanent Marker performs best outdoors in sunny, low-humidity regions. Choose a location with maximum sunlight and minimal late-season rain. Raised beds, breathable soil, and optional canopy covers help protect against moisture and ensure optimal root health and bud development.

Growing Medium: Soil for flavor, hydroponics for yield Organic soil enhances Permanent Marker’s complex terpene expression—ideal for flavor-focused growers. Hydroponic setups can accelerate growth and increase yield potential, though they require more precise nutrient and pH management. Either medium can produce premium results depending on your cultivation style.

Bud Structure: Dense, oversized, and heavily resinous Permanent Marker produces large, tightly packed spade-shaped buds known for their remarkable density and sticky resin output. This structure helps trap its chemical-candy aroma and makes the strain highly desirable for users seeking premium, high-potency flower with exceptional bag appeal.

Coloration: Bright emerald green with purple accents The buds typically feature vibrant emerald-green hues contrasted by deep purple streaks—especially in colder nighttime temperatures. Fiery orange pistils weave through the flower, giving Permanent Marker a colorful, visually striking appearance that reflects its designer lineage.

Trichome Coverage: Extremely thick and sugary Permanent Marker is known for its intense trichome saturation, forming a frosty, amber-tinted layer that signals its high THC content. This heavy resin production enhances both potency and aroma, making the strain an excellent candidate for solventless hash, rosin, and other concentrate extractions.

Temperature Control: Cooler nights enhance color and resin Permanent Marker responds extremely well to slightly cooler nighttime temperatures—around 55–65°F during the final weeks of flowering. This temperature shift can intensify purple hues in certain phenotypes and promote heavier trichome production, improving both potency and visual appeal.

Humidity Management: Maintain RH below 50% Due to its thick, sticky, and tightly packed buds, Permanent Marker is susceptible to moisture-related issues. Keep relative humidity under 50% during flowering, and ensure strong airflow with oscillating fans and proper exhaust systems to prevent mold, mildew, or terpene degradation.

Nutrient Balance: Prioritize phosphorus and potassium in bloom During flowering, Permanent Marker thrives on elevated phosphorus and potassium levels to maximize bud density, terpene expression, and resin output. Reduce nitrogen in late flower to avoid leafy growth and ensure a cleaner, more flavorful final product.

Pest Control: Consistent monitoring and organic protection Regularly inspect plants for common pests such as spider mites, thrips, and aphids, as Permanent Marker’s dense canopy can create hiding spots. Utilize organic solutions like neem oil, insecticidal soap, or predatory insects such as ladybugs or lacewings to maintain a healthy, pest-free environment.

meta.jar_headline: What to look for in the jar.
meta.jar_html:
Permanent Marker is instantly recognizable for its dense, oversized bud structure and heavily resinous texture. These tightly formed, spade-shaped nugs showcase the strain’s designer genetics, boasting a thick blanket of trichomes that glisten under light.

The coloration of Permanent Marker adds to its premium presentation. Buds typically display bright emerald-green tones, often contrasted with deep purple streaks when grown in cooler environments. Fiery orange pistils weave through the flower, standing out against a shimmering layer of amber-tinted and milky-white trichomes. As the plant approaches peak maturity—usually near the end of its 8–10 week flowering cycle—its resin production intensifies, signaling optimal cannabinoid and terpene development.

Beyond aesthetics, Permanent Marker’s frosty, sticky coating is responsible for its potent chemical-candy aroma and heavy-hitting effects.

From a cultivation standpoint, Permanent Marker’s physical traits—bud shape, pistil coloration, trichome opacity, and resin thickness—serve as reliable markers of harvest readiness. Under natural light or magnification, these visual cues highlight the strain’s elite genetic background and its suitability for high-end craft cannabis production. Whether you’re a casual consumer or a seasoned grower, Permanent Marker’s appearance immediately communicates what the strain is known for: potency, complexity, and exceptional bag appeal.

item-0.question: What Is Permanent Marker an indica or sativa??
item-0.answer: Permanent Marker is an indica-leaning hybrid , bred from Biscotti × Sherb Bx × Jealousy. It offers a balanced mix of cerebral euphoria and deep physical relaxation, leaning slightly more toward calming, body-focused effects.

item-1.question: How strong is Permanent Marker?
item-1.answer: Permanent Marker is considered a very potent strain , with THC levels typically ranging from 25% to 35%+ . It is best suited for moderate to high-tolerance users who are comfortable with strong, fast-acting effects.

item-2.question: What does Permanent Marker taste like?
item-2.answer: Permanent Marker has a unique flavor profile featuring chemical-candy sweetness, floral notes, sour citrus, and gassy diesel. Many users describe it as having a slightly “marker-like” edge, which contributes to its distinctive name.

item-3.question: What does Permanent Marker smell like?
item-3.answer: This strain offers a bold, room-filling aroma of chemical funk, candy sweetness, floral soapiness, and sharp gas . Its pungency makes it easy to identify and highly sought after among terpene enthusiasts.

item-4.question: What effects does Permanent Marker produce?
item-4.answer: Common effects include euphoria, tingly body sensations, deep relaxation, mental uplift , and enhanced creativity. Many users report feeling calm yet mentally stimulated, making it great for unwinding or low-key creative activities.

item-5.question: What medical conditions may Permanent Marker help with?
item-5.answer: While results vary, users often turn to Permanent Marker for relief from stress, anxiety, depression symptoms, chronic pain, PMS or cramps, fatigue , and PTSD-related discomfort. Its calming body high makes it suitable for evening wellness use.

item-6.question: Is Permanent Marker good for beginners?
item-6.answer: Because of its high THC content , Permanent Marker is generally recommended for experienced users. Beginners should start with a very low dose to avoid potential side effects such as dizziness, anxiety, or overwhelming sedation.

item-7.question: How long do the effects of Permanent Marker last?
item-7.answer: The effects typically last 2–4 hours , depending on dose, tolerance, and method of consumption. Edibles made with Permanent Marker can last significantly longer—up to 6+ hours .

item-8.question: What strains are similar to Permanent Marker?
item-8.answer: Strains with similar effects or terpene profiles include Frosted Cherry Cookies, Supermax OG, Cake Bomb, Dawg’s Waltz , and other heavy myrcene-dominant hybrids. On our menu, customers often compare it to Plum Popperz, STIIIZY OG, Biscotti Mintz , and Dark Matter .
